title: Netflix to Become the New Home of WWE in Japan
summary: Raw, SmackDown, NXT and Premium Live Events To Begin Streaming Exclusively from October 1, 2026.
body_markdown:
Netflix today announced that, beginning October 1, 2026, it will become the new home for WWE programming in Japan. The lineup will include WWE's weekly flagship shows —


Raw


,


SmackDown


and


NXT


— along with Premium Live Events such as


WrestleMania


,


Royal Rumble


,


SummerSlam


and


Money in the Bank


, as well as WWE's archive library, all streaming exclusively on Netflix. Included at no extra cost across all Netflix plans


1 , members will be able to enjoy the thrilling matches that have captivated fans around the world all year-round — live in real time, and anytime, anywhere. Live broadcasts will feature original English commentary as well as Japanese commentary.


For more than three decades, WWE has been the global leader in sports entertainment, captivating fans worldwide. On its roster, Japanese-born superstars such as IYO SKY, Asuka, Shinsuke Nakamura, KYOKI, and NARAKU are also competing at the highest level on the world stage.


Netflix began


[streaming WWE globally](https://about.netflix.com/en/news/netflix-to-become-new-home-of-wwe-raw-beginning-2025) in January 2025 (with some regions excluded)and has since built a strong track record in WWE streaming. The debut Netflix live streaming drew 4.9 million views


2 and #WWERaw is consistently the #1 trending topic on X. By combining WWE's passionate, multigenerational fandom with Netflix's global reach, the partnership has continued to create dynamic, engaging kinds of viewing experiences.


Members in Japan will also be able to watch WWE matches and related content — including the documentary


WWE: Unreal


anytime, anywhere, on any internet-connected device, from smartphones to TVs. Whether they've followed WWE for years or are discovering it for the first time, Netflix will deliver an experience that lets every fan enjoy the world of WWE in whatever way suits them.


More details about the program schedule and special content will be announced on Netflix's official social media channels.


Raw


First live streaming in Japan: Tuesday, October 6, from 9am, streaming live every Tuesday at 9am thereafter (10am once US Daylight Saving Time ends)


WWE's groundbreaking, Superstar-studded in-ring series delivers live action, drama and unmatched athleticism every week.


SmackDown


First live streaming in Japan: Saturday, October 3, from 9am, streaming live every Saturday at 9am thereafter (10 am once US Daylight Saving Time ends)


WWE's top superstars settle scores and spark rivalries in weekly in-ring competition featuring action-packed matches from the blue brand..


NXT


First live broadcast in Japan: Wednesday, October 7, from 9am, streaming live every Wednesday at 9am thereafter (10am once US Daylight Saving Time ends)


The brightest up-and-coming competitors collide in their pursuit of becoming the hottest Superstars in sports-entertainment.


Upcoming WWE Premium Live Events


-


Money in the Bank 2026


: Streaming live at 7:00 a.m. JST on Sunday, October 11


-


Crown Jewel in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia


: Saturday, November 7 (local time)


-


Survivor Series: WarGames 2026


: Streaming live at 8:00 a.m. JST on Sunday, November 29


-


Wrestlepalooza


: Perth: Saturday, December 12 (local time)


---


1 Available on all Netflix plans including Standard with ads, Standard, and Premium. Live programming includes ads regardless of plan (excluding on-demand/archive viewing).


2 Views are the total view hours for the program divided by the runtime and do not include co-viewing. Data is cut off at midnight PST each day. Does not include viewing in 92 countries/territories where Netflix had not yet distributed WWE at the time, including France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, the Philippines, and South Korea.
